messages:
Sophie: Quick heads-up 
partners pushed tentative firmware windows for H100/H200 and MI300. Can we do a short cadence sync later today to map marketplace announcement lanes? :calendar: 
Devon: yep, Im booked at 10:30 and 15:00 PT but can do early.
Lina: early works. We should include SI integrator leads + cloud marketplace PMs.
Raj: main question: gate GA on certified images or soft-GA with explicit compatibility matrix?
Sophie: leaning soft-GA for H200/B200 variants, hard GA for H100/MI300 once certified. Need embargo plan for press and partner comms.
Devon: also need fallback model routing if an instance types flaps  route to Dedicated-equivalent for 24h.
Lina: lab note: Gaudi can be certified in ~3w if vendor provides kernel. MI300 waiting on microcode.
HW-Bot: [build-status] gaudi-lab-image queued -> ETA 2024-06-10 (vendor).
Sophie: Can someone draft a decision table? cols: Vendor | SKU | Cert ETA | Announce lane | Comm owner | Fallback. Ill take comms.
Raj: Ill own fallback routing playbook snippet. Devon: marketplace tagging & SKU mapping.
Devon: drafting tags now: redwood:hw:mi300-ga, redwood:hw:h200-softga.
Lina: propose 9:00 PT sync tomorrow with SI + marketplace PMs. Ill send calendar + agenda.
Sophie: agenda: 1) Cert status & blockers; 2) Announce lanes & embargo windows; 3) Fallback routing & Dedicated handoff; 4) SI readiness checklist.
Raj: will ping Legal about firmware embargo constraints once ETAs are firm.
Devon: posting SKU mapping draft in #partnerships shortly. :thumbsup: 
Sophie: thanks. Post updates here so embargo calc can be rerun if ETAs shift.
